title: eval-harness: add CI hooks for prompt-set regression metrics and quality gating
author: Liam Parker
release_notes: Add CI integration to run prompt-set regression checks and gating metrics; enables automatic failure on quality regressions for release branches.
description: Motivation: prevent prompt-set regressions from reaching main by running eval-harness metrics as part of CI and gating merges when quality drops relative to baseline. This PR adds CI hooks, a new metrics adapter, and a configurable gating rule set for per-prompt-set thresholds. Changes include: 1) a GitHub Actions workflow (eval-regression.yml) that runs the eval-harness suite on pushed PR heads and on scheduled baselines; 2) a lightweight metrics adapter that uploads aggregated eval metrics to the existing CI artifacts endpoint and compares against stored baselines; 3) gating logic that fails the job when configured thresholds are exceeded and annotates the PR with a summary; 4) documentation updates and a migration guide for maintainers. Implementation notes: baseline artifacts are stored per-branch in S3 with retention and a backfill script included; the gating config supports per-prompt-set rules and severity levels (warning/blocking). This PR aims to be opt-in via the eval/enable-regression label and default-off for release branches until we complete a two-week pilot. Checklist: ensure the baseline backfill runs on schedule; validate user permissions for artifact upload; add e2e tests to the perf-canary job; update runbooks for oncall. Related: ENG-4210 (eval infra), SUP-1123 (customer-reported regression), design doc link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4210/eval-ci-hooks; See small migration note in docs/ci/README.md.
